parameters.example: End-to-end coverage from order creation to payment
parameters.help_en: The description of the model, used for explanatory text. For short titles displayed in the UI, use displayName
parameters.help_zh: 模型描述，用于填写说明文字。界面展示的短标题请使用 `displayName`
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The display name used as a short title for UI display. It can contain Chinese characters, spaces, and punctuation marks, and can be up to 256 characters in length (counted by characters, not bytes). If you do not specify this parameter or specify an empty string, the display name is not set. In this case, the API returns an empty string `""` instead of backfilling it with the name value. For display purposes, you can fall back to displayName || name
parameters.help_zh: 显示名，供界面展示的短标题，可使用中文、空格与标点，长度上限 256 个字符（按字符数计算，非字节数）。不传或传空串表示未设置，此时接口回显空串 `""`（不会回填成 `name`），展示时可按 `displayName || name` 回退
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the context model. It can contain only letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and can be up to 64 characters in length. It must be unique within the same Alibaba Cloud account and cannot be modified after creation. All other context model API operations use this name to locate the resource
parameters.help_zh: 上下文模型的标识。仅支持大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）与短横线（-），长度不超过 64 个字符；在同一主账号下唯一，创建后不可修改，其余上下文模型接口均以该名称定位资源
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The referenced sources. The key is the project name (so the same project does not appear repeatedly), and the value is an array of selected Logstore names under the project. `["*"]` indicates all Logstores under the project. Otherwise, it is a list of exact Logstore names. Note: An empty array `[]` is rejected (400). To select all, you must explicitly specify `["*"]` to prevent an accidentally passed empty set from being expanded to all Logstores. `["*"]` cannot be mixed with specific Logstore names (400). Wildcard or prefix matching is not supported. Names containing `*` are rejected (400). If you do not specify this field, no sources are referenced
parameters.help_zh: 引用的源：以 Project 名为 key（故同一 Project 不会重复出现），值为该 Project 下框选的 Logstore 名数组。`["*"]` 表示该 Project 下全部 Logstore；否则为精确的 Logstore 名列表。注意：空数组 `[]` 会被拒绝（400），全选必须显式写 `["*"]`，以免误传的空集合被放大成全量。`["*"]` 不可与具体 Logstore 名混写（400）。暂不支持通配/前缀匹配，名字中含 `*` 会被拒绝（400）。不传该字段表示不引用任何源
parameters.name: sources

status.description_en: The status of the call result. If the creation is successful, success is returned. If the call fails, the failure is indicated by the HTTP status code and errorCode, and this field is not returned
status.description_zh: 调用结果状态。创建成功时固定返回 success；调用失败时通过 HTTP 状态码与 errorCode 表达，不返回该字段

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body. A JSON object that describes the context model to be created, including the model identifier, display name, description, and referenced sources
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。JSON 对象，描述待创建的上下文模型（ContextModel），包含模型标识、显示名、描述以及引用的源
v1_body_parameters.name: body
